content: Jesúsja ccase qquendya
Sema'ma'qquia a'ta pasasi faesu avujaquive a'tasi coe'je tseyi deji'ni María Magdalena, faesu Maríai'ccu atu'ttima can'su ja'fa.
Jayi'ni tse'faei'ccuyi ande quia'me oya. Oyasi Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'su Chiga sefaccone andepa patuma mutsinoe joqquitssian. Joqquitssiamba tsanga dyai.
Tsanda veyaenqquia'caen tiseja a'tatssia've chanjun. Tise ondiccu'je'qque chandisu'ccoa'caen tototssi.
Coira'su sundarondeccu'qque tisema attepa ttun'dundu'je'e dyopa paqquia'caen amppi ccui'fa.
Tsomba pushesundeccu catsesi Chigama sefacconi'su shondo'suja tise'pama su: —Dyombe can'faja. In'jan gi que'ija avuja'cconga fi'tti'fa'cho Jesúsve qui ttattacan'fa.
Tiseja vani can'jembi. Tise tayoe suqquia'caen ccase qquendya. Jipa tise ccui'ttima can'faja.
Can'gipa utatsseyi japa tisema shondosundeccunga conda'faja: “Tiseja papa tayo ccase qquendyapa que'ima o'tie tsu Galileani jaya. Tseni japa qui tisema atte'faya.” Tayo gi conda ña suya'choma.
Qquen susi pushesundeccu utatsseyi atu'tti'ye sombopa dyopa ja'fa. Dyo'a'qque ñoa'me avujatsse Jesúsma shondosundeccunga condaye ja'fa.
Jayi'fasi tse'faei'ccuyi Jesús tise'pama cachuipa chigambian. Chigambiansi tisenga catsepa ccaru dyaipa tise tsu'ttema munsin indi'fa. Munsin indipa tisema in'jamba ñotsse afa'fa.
Tsonsi Jesús tise'panga su: —Dyombe can'faja. Japa ña faengasundeccunga conda'faja cuintsu Galileani ja'faye. Tseni japa tsu ñama atte'faya.
Sundarondeccu condase'cho
Pushesundeccu ja'je'ni atu'ttima coira'su sundarondeccu'su'qque canqqueni japa Chigama afa'su nasundeccunga conda'fa ma'caen da'choma.
Conda'fasi Chigama afa'su nasundeccu, israe'su coenzandeccui'ccu asi'ttaemba condasecco'fa jongoe qquen suya'chove. Asi'ttaemba in'jan'fa. In'jamba sundarondeccunga tsain'bitssia corifin'dima afepa
su'fa: —Qquen cca'indeccunga su'faja: “Enttinge cose ingi ana'jen'ni Jesúsma shondosundeccu jipa tise ai'voma cca'namba anga'fa.”
Qquen susi governaror paña'ninda gi tisema afaya que'ima noñangiansa'ne.
Qquen su'fasi sundarondeccu corifin'dima isupa tsendeccu mandaqquia'caen tsu su'fa. Tsa'caen su'fasi ja'ño a'ta pán tsu poi israendeccu tsa'caen pañamba in'jan'fa.
Shondosundeccuma manda'cho
Jesús mandaqquia'caen tisema once shondosundeccu Galileani ja'fa. Jesús su'cho ccotta'cconga japa
tse'ttinga tisema cachui'fa. Cachuipa tisema in'jamba ñotsse afa'fa. Tsa'ma majan tisema attepa injama'cho shacasi ñoa'me Jesús tsu qquen in'jan'fambi.
Tsonsi Jesús tise'panga catsepa su: —Chiga Quitsa tsu ñanga antte pa'cco Chiga sefacconima, pa'cco andenima'qque mandaye.

Tsa'cansi que'i poi ande'su aindeccunga japa tise'pama in'jaen'faja cuintsu ñama shondosundeccuve da'faye. Nane Chiga Quitsa, Tise Dutssi'ye, Chiga Qquendya'pama'qque in'jan'fasi tsu tise'pama feti'faya'cho.

Toya'caen pa'cco ña que'ima mandaqquia'caen qui tise'pama'qque atesiaña'cho cuintsu tsa'caen pañamba tson'faye. Tsa'caen in'jaemba ñotsse in'jan'faja: Tsangae osefaeña'gae gi que'i'ccu can'jeña. Tsangaeyi.
